newsitem.title: USA: Dow whipsaws in negative ground, curbs lifted.
newsitem.headline: Dow whipsaws in negative ground, curbs lifted.

text.p: The Dow industrials gyrated at negative levels in jittery morning trade Wednesday after opening higher with an eye on the 8,000 level.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average was down 33 points at 7939. Earlier, it rose as high as 7991.
The Dow's slide prompted the New York Stock Exchange to impose trading curbs at 1054 EDT/1454 GMT. Six minutes later, the index recouped a bit and the curbs were lifted.
The Nasdaq composite index was stronger but was also below intraday highs. It was up three points at 1488 as technology stocks firmed amid upbeat prospects for earnings.
